_readme: Per-test overrides for unattended refreshes, keyed by Intelligems experience id. 'groups' replaces the traffic groups parsed from the test's [TAG] (use when a tag doesn't match its real targeting). 'note' is appended to the automatically generated note: use it for context the data checks can't know. Delete an entry when the test ends or the tag is fixed.
